Title: 502824-2026: Italy – Construction work for hospital facilities – OPEN TENDERING PROCEDURE FOR THE CONCLUSION OF A FRAMEWORK AGREEMENT, PURSUANT TO ARTICLES 71 AND 59, PARA. 4, LETT. A), OF THE PUBLIC CONTRACTS CODE, WITH SEVERAL ECONOMIC OPERATORS FOR THE AWARD OF WORKS (OS21, OG1 AND OG11) RELATING TO THE SEISMIC UPGRADING OF THE HISTORIC MONOBLOCK OF THE POLICLINICO DI MODENA CUP: F94E16001530002 - F94E22000660003 CIG: B8CAC67189
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Seismic strengthening of a historic large hospital is a demanding structural engineering task and therefore relevant for sbp. Points deducted because it is a framework agreement in Italy (outside DACH/Africa) and therefore lower priority.
titel: Open procedure for the conclusion of a framework agreement with several economic operators for construction works for the seismic upgrading of the historic monoblock of the Policlinico di Modena
kurzbeschreibung: In Modena (Italy), a framework agreement of around EUR 22.2 million was awarded for construction works for the seismic upgrading of the historic monoblock of the Policlinico di Modena. Several construction companies were selected for the execution of the construction works; planning services were not part of the tender.
wettbewerb_art: Open procurement procedure for construction works (framework agreement)
gewinner: AR.CO. LAVORI SOC. COOP. CONS. (lead contractor) with HANA S.R.L., SELI MANUTENZIONI GENERALI S.R.L., VF COSTRUZIONI E RESTAURI S.R.L. and COSEDIL S.P.A.
gewinner_rolle: Construction company / construction consortium (execution of construction works)
gewinner_kontakt: Contract value of framework agreement (Lot 1, Rank 1): EUR 11,099,987.58 (excluding VAT)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Framework agreement for construction works, no structural design services tendered
- Seismic upgrading of a hospital building, technically interesting but primarily construction execution
- Location outside DACH and without clear need for special structures or bridges
- sbp is typically not active as a construction contractor
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in Italy, checking engineer services not explicitly tendered
- Seismic upgrading could theoretically require external checking services, but there are no indications of this in the TED text
- Framework agreement exclusively for construction works (OS21, OG1, OG11), planning or checking services are not included
baukosten_erklaerung: taken from notice (estimated value of the framework agreement excluding VAT)
naechste_schritte: No active contact recommended; only passive monitoring of the project. If separate tenders for structural design or independent checking services for the seismic upgrading are published, review them separately.
notes: Framework agreement with several economic operators for construction works for the seismic upgrading of the historic monoblock of the Policlinico di Modena (hospital). CPV 45215140 (Construction work for hospital facilities). Award criterion: most economically advantageous tender with 90 points for technical quality and 10 points for price. Structural design or engineering planning services are not included in the present procedure; it concerns pure construction works (OS21, OG1, OG11). For sbp not directly relevant either as designer or as checking engineer.
